_source: CAPTURED 2026-10-01: one real refresh_token grant through google_client (the POST every briefing makes to https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token) for the owner's Personal account returned exactly these four keys: access_token (str), expires_in (int), scope (str, space separated), token_type (str). No refresh_token or id_token comes back on a refresh. access_token is invented; expires_in and token_type are the captured values; scope is the captured list in the captured order with https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar removed, which is what an unticked Calendar box produces.
